bio: Enjoy everyday luxury and escape to Victors with our modern Asian inspired menu and show stopping cocktails.  Beautiful, vibrant, upscale yet informal, Victors Alderley Edge is the perfect restaurant for everything from celebrations to intimate dining. Located along Ashley Road, right in the heart of Hale and just a few miles from Altrincham.  Introducing Afternoon Tea #TheVictorsWay. Indulge in a delightful selection of homemade luxury treats, from classic sandwiches including a Turkey & Avocado Finger Sandwich to an array of sweet desserts including Victors Chocolate & Hazelnut Cookie. Served at your table with sparklers and dry ice, Afternoon Tea at Victors is like no other.
